captions.detailed: A classic reel-style slot machine cabinet featuring a deep red main body, a curved top marquee box, and golden-yellow trim around the display areas. The central display includes a reel window with three white cylindrical reels, while a black button shelf projects forward from the middle of the cabinet and holds three colorful push buttons (red, yellow, and blue). Below the button shelf, a black service door is recessed into the lower cabinet face. The lower service door is designed to hinge open along its left vertical edge, and each of the three colored buttons on the shelf can be pressed down independently.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tall reel-style slot machine with a curved top box, a central display window with three reels, a protruding front button shelf with three colorful push buttons, and a lower service door. The model should include articulation joints allowing the lower service door to swing open on a vertical side hinge and the buttons to press downward as individual prismatic controls.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using a hollowed or subtractive Box primitive, and add a curved marquee on top using a filleted or combined Box. Create the central reel window with three Cylinder primitives representing the reels, framed by gold-colored decorative trim. Build the protruding button shelf as a black Box, and place three small Cylinder primitives on top to act as the buttons. Model the lower service door as a thin black Box, and define a revolute joint along its left side for rotation, as well as three independent prismatic joints for the vertical movement of each button.
